modelOverview: The Tank Must Small is the smallest of the core sizes in Cartier's 2021 revival of the Must de Cartier line, the steel-cased, more accessible reading of Louis Cartier's 1917 Tank first produced in 1977. Cased at 29.5mm x 22mm in steel with a high-autonomy quartz movement, it keeps the Roman-numeral dial, blued-steel sword hands and beaded spinel-set crown of the larger models, and is offered on interchangeable leather straps or a steel bracelet, with diamond-set bezels on selected references.

WSTA0042.materials: Stainless steel case; interchangeable black grained calfskin strap with steel ardillon buckle
WSTA0042.dial: Silvered dial with black Roman numerals and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; beaded crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
WSTA0042.description: Note: Cartier lists reference WSTA0042 as the Small-model Tank Must with a silvered dial rather than a green-dial Large model. It is the standard leather-strap configuration of the 2021 relaunch, pairing the 29.5mm x 22mm steel case with a silvered Roman-numeral dial, blued sword hands and a high-autonomy quartz movement. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver Dial: Small-model Tank Must in steel on an interchangeable black grained calfskin strap, with a silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands (documented by Cartier as silvered rather than green).

variants.Steel Bracelet – Silver Dial: Small-model Tank Must in steel on the interchangeable steel bracelet, with a silvered Roman-numeral dial, blued-steel sword hands and a spinel-set beaded crown.

Forty brilliant-cut diamonds frame the silvered Roman-numeral dial, and the watch runs Cartier's high-autonomy quartz movement on a black calfskin strap. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
